intro: Soft, textured, and effortlessly cosy, this cotton throw brings a touch of warmth and understated elegance to any space. Perfect for curling up or simply adding charm to your decor.

features.title: Spun from clouds, woven in time
features.text: Made from soft, breathable cotton, this throw provides a lasting, comfortable feel, making it a go-to piece for daily relaxation or cosy evenings at home.

features.title: Aesthetic Enhancements for Spaces
features.text: Whether draped over your couch or bed, this throw infuses your room with effortless charm, adding color and texture that enhances any interior style.

features.title: Wrapped in warmth
features.text: Not just for style, this throw provides warmth when needed and protects your furniture from spills and wear, offering both practicality and elegance in one.

care: Gentle Machine Wash, Do Not Bleach, Tumble Dry Low, Iron If Needed, Do Not Dry clean
name: 50x70 Cotton Throw
